definitions.gloss: new ground; new frontier; new territory; new realm
definitions.explanation: A previously unexplored area of activity, thought, or creative expression. Used when someone breaks into a new field or achieves something unprecedented.

examples.japanese: {新境地|しんきょうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a work that opened up new ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦ベテラン→ベテラン：11121_beteran⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{新境地|しんきょうち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑|いど}んでいる→挑む：12708_idomu⟧。
examples.english: The veteran actor is venturing into new territory.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新境地|しんきょうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{拓|ひら}くものだ。
examples.english: This technology will pioneer new frontiers in medicine.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to open up) or ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{拓|ひら}く (to pioneer). Carries a positive connotation of breaking new ground and expanding one's capabilities or achievements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新境地|しんきょうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to open up new ground)
- {新境地|しんきょうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{拓|ひら}く (to pioneer new territory)
- {新境地|しんきょうち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧ (to take on new territory)
- {新境地|しんきょうち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧ (to reach new territory)
